name: Weight-bearing wrist extension
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place the test hand flat in front of you with fingers pointing forward and the elbow straight.
Keeping the whole palm and the heel of the hand on the floor, slowly lean your shoulder forward over your fingers as far as you can.
Hold the end position for 2 seconds. Stop where the heel of the hand starts to lift.
Lay a phone inclinometer along your forearm and read how many degrees it tilts away from straight up.
Your score is 90 plus that tilt if your shoulder is in front of your hand (toward the fingers), or 90 minus the tilt if it is behind. A vertical forearm scores 90.
